name: @noralos-plugins/noralai-zoho
description: NoralAI Zoho CRM integration. Wraps the Zoho CRM REST API behind a NoralOS-branded plugin surface using OAuth 2.0 (refresh-token) credentials from the company's integration_credentials row. Exposes agent tools for searching modules, reading/creating/updating records (Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Deals, etc.) so Brooklyn and director-tier agents can read CRM context and log activity mid-conversation.
